text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing changes in your mental status, so I need to ask a few questions to determine the cause. Can you describe exactly what you have been feeling or experiencing regarding your confusion or behavior changes?

text: Thank you for that information. To help narrow down the cause, has the patient experienced any recent fever, headache, or neck stiffness? Additionally, are there any changes in her speech, vision, or motor function, such as weakness on one side of the body?
